svg.aria-label: Electromagnetic spectrum from gamma rays through X-rays, ultraviolet, visible light, infrared and microwaves to radio waves; wavelength grows to the right while frequency and energy grow to the left
svg.title: Electromagnetic spectrum with visible light expanded

g.text: Log scale: each tick is ×10 in wavelength. Band edges are conventional and approximate; gamma rays,
X-rays and part of the UV are ionising. All bands travel at the speed of light, c = λ × f.
